items.title: Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben. Die Frist beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei Versand durch die Post am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post eintritt.
items.computation: Letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); assuming this is also the day it was handed to the post (Aufgabe zur Post), the statutory delivery fiction under §122 Abs.2 AO (as currently in force, 4-day rule) sets Bekanntgabe on 19.11.2026 + 4 calendar days = 23.11.2026 (a Monday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed since the 4th day itself is not a deadline end, just the notification date). The one-month Einspruchsfrist then runs per §108 AO i.V.m. §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day after Bekanntgabe (24.11.2026) is the first day counted, and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no shift is required. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.

items.title: Refund interest paid out with tax refund
items.quote: Der Betrag wird mit der Erstattung überwiesen.
items.computation: The letter states only that the 42,00 € interest amount will be transferred together with the underlying income tax refund, without giving a specific calendar date or deadline for that transfer; no due date can therefore be determined from this letter.

warnings: The 4-day postal delivery fiction (“am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post”) is applied as printed; the calculation assumes the letter's document date (19.11.2026) is also the day it was handed to the post, which is not explicitly stated and could shift the Einspruch deadline by a day or two if the actual posting date differs.
No concrete date is given for when the 42,00 € interest will actually be paid out, only that it accompanies the (also undated) income tax refund payment.
